title: French Bulldog Popularity Hid A 4.5-Year Lifespan
hook: The top French Bulldog ranking hides a 4.5-year life expectancy.
closing: Popularity cannot tell you how long a breed is likely to live.
question: Would lifespan change your breed choice?

segments.say: French Bulldog ranked 1st, pushing Labrador Retriever to 2nd.
French Bulldog registrations rose 1,000% between 2012 and 2022.
French Bulldog life expectancy was 4.5 years versus Labrador Retriever's 11.8.
